title: Pay by name on a private chain
description: Bob owes money to Alice and Dave and does not know where they receive it. He pays them by name, in a registry that Carol made. Play the five of them yourself, in five tmux windows, on a private Cardano test chain. Ubuntu, nothing to install.

steps.title: Setup: five wallets and a private chain
Carol creates the registry and publishes it
Alice checks the registry before she uses it
Bob checks the registry and asks
Dave checks the registry Bob named
Dave registers his name and replies
Alice and Dave move their money
What this does, and where it stops
